Class InputStreamTokenizer

java.lang.Object
bg.tu_varna.sit.cs.f24621858.image.inputOutput.InputStreamTokenizer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Tokenizer
Direct Known Subclasses:
FileHeaderTokenizer
public abstract class InputStreamTokenizer extends Object implements Tokenizer
Abstract base for Tokenizer implementations that read from a FileInputStream.

Subclasses must implement Tokenizer.skipToTheToken() to define what constitutes "whitespace" and "comment" for the particular file format.

Author:
Dmitro Dashchenko
